name: FFS_RESOURCE
description: Used to stores all created resources.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the resource.

columns.name: ACTIVE
columns.description: Indicates current resource availability status. Values: 1 - active, 0 - inactive.

columns.name: PARENT
columns.description: Unique identifier of a parent resources. If this resource is the top resource in the hierarchy then the value is 0.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the resource used for integrations (external identifier).

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Indicates type of the resource.

columns.name: QTS_BUCKET_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Defines if this resource is also used as a capacity area. It happens when a value of this field is equal to 'resource_id'.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: The name of the resource. The maximum character length of this field is 40 characters.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an organization this resource belongs to.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a preferred language for the resource.

columns.name: TIME_FORMAT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a preferred time format for the resource.

columns.name: DATE_FORMAT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a preferred date format for the resource.

columns.name: TIME_ZONE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier a time zone for the resource.

columns.name: EMAIL
columns.description: Email address of the resource. The maximum character length of this field is 255 characters.

columns.name: PHONE
columns.description: Phone number of the resource. The maximum character length of this field is 16 characters. Only digits and plus sign are allowed (e.g. '+123456789').

columns.name: CREATED
columns.description: Indicates the date and time of the resource creation.

columns.name: UPDATED
columns.description: Indicates the date and time of the resource most recent update.

columns.name: TRAVEL_KEY
columns.description: Resource Travel Key. Filled automatically based on configured 'Resource Travel Key' on Business Rules screen.

columns.name: SD_KEY
columns.description: Unique identifier for Resource Duration key value.

columns.name: STARTTIMEKEY
columns.description: Deprecated field, can be removed.

columns.name: SCHEDULING_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the scheduling profile which the configuration of the resource is related to. It is the foreign key to the table FFS_SCHEDULING_PROFILE.

columns.name: FEATURES
columns.description: Bit mask: 2 - route owner, 4 - is a bucket, 16 - allow child providers, 32 - allow to assist to, 64 - allow to be a teamholder, 128 - share inventory in teamwork, 256 - allow users, 512 - enable capacity, 1024 - use in routing, 2048 - starting travel is worktime, 4096 - ending travel is worktime, 8192 - track location, 16384 - share location in teamwork, 32768 - enable 'not activate in time' alert, 65536 - share work skills in teamwork, 131072 - contingent workers, 262144 - is a warehouse.

columns.name: COLOR
columns.description: Hex color (6 hex symbols, e.g. 'FF0000'). Used as a background color for resource's avatar in graphical interface.

columns.name: SD_INITIAL_RATIO
columns.description: Initial ratio for the calculation of an activity duration when the resource is new.

columns.name: SD_INITIAL_RATIO_READONLY
columns.description: Parameter to indicate if the Initial ratio of the resource was modified by Stats duration job.

columns.name: SKIP_DAYS_FOR_STATS
columns.description: Indicates number of days which are skipped for learning statistics.

columns.name: SKIP_DAYS_UPDATED
columns.description: Indicates the date and time of most recent SKIP_DAYS_FOR_STATS update.

columns.name: ORGANIZATION_ID_OLD
columns.description: Deprecated. Was used as a backup ORGANIZATION_ID field while upgrading from 23B to 23C version.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the party. Reference to HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID.
